Architecture

account_tree Pipeline Diagram Ingress, Inspection, and Telemetry Flow
1
Ingress & LuaJIT Pre-flight

Traffic arrives on OpenResty worker threads. Custom Lua sensors perform rapid dynamic bypass, geo-filtering, and initial validation before invoking inspection.
2
ModSecurity v3 & CRS Rules

Comprehensive payload parsing and regex evaluation against OWASP Core Rule Set 4.25+. Granular per-route sensor policies enable dynamic rule tailoring without reloads.
3
IPXA Feeds & DuckDB Telemetry

Continuous threat intelligence synchronized with IPXA. All audit logs and blocked transactions are saved in embedded DuckDB for instant analytics and reporting.
